column2: 原文
column3: 译文

column2: Anti-tank units are good at softening up tanks at a range of 2.
column3: 反坦克单位擅长在 2 格外削弱坦克。

column2: Plane movement is halted if moved within range of a hidden Air Defense unit capable of engaging it.
column3: 飞机进入可对其开火的隐蔽防空单位射程内时，其移动将中止。

column2: Infantry is best at attacking and defending from towns, forests, and mountains.
column3: 步兵在城市、森林与山地攻防最佳。

column2: Move a unit adjacent to the enemy to fully spot them.
column3: 将部队移动到敌军相邻格，以完全侦察其动向。

column2: Partially spotted units have better defense than spotted units.
column3: 部分被侦察的部队，防御优于完全暴露的部队。

column2: Recon units are easily spotted, but they screen your other nearby units.
column3: 侦察单位容易被发现，但能掩护附近的友军。

column2: Recon units can stagger their movement into separate stages.
column3: 侦察单位可将移动分为多个阶段。

column2: Never leave light infantry out in open and clear terrain.
column3: 切勿让轻步兵暴露在开阔地形中。

column2: Focus on taking victory hexes, not just killing enemy units.
column3: 着眼于夺取胜利格，而非仅仅歼灭敌军。

column2: Artillery and air strikes reduce enemy entrenchment values by 1 point per attack.
column3: 炮击与空袭每次可使敌方工事值降低 1 点。

column2: Kill off a wounded enemy unit before it gets the chance to reinforce again.
column3: 在受损敌军获得补充之前将其歼灭。

column2: Engage enemy armor with anti-tank units from a distance.
column3: 用反坦克单位在远距离对付敌方装甲。

column2: Drop your air mobile units deep behind enemy lines to take victory objectives.
column3: 将空中机动部队投送至敌后纵深，夺取胜利目标。

column2: When you requisition new units, don't forget to add Attachments.
column3: 征募新部队时，别忘了添加附属编制。

column2: A Tank that overruns an enemy unit can continue its attack if it still has movement allowance left.
column3: 坦克碾压敌军后若仍有剩余移动力，可继续攻击。

column2: Don't attack well-entrenched infantry units in city hexes with your tanks.
column3: 不要用坦克攻击城市格中工事坚固的步兵。

column2: Keep your artillery close enough to the front lines to support your troops.
column3: 让炮兵靠前到足以支援前线部队。

column2: Air liftable units can only fly from friendly airport to friendly airport.
column3: 可空运单位只能在友方机场之间飞行。

column2: In a campaign, you can 'over-strength' your units between scenarios to increase their effectiveness.
column3: 在战役中，你可以在场景之间超编部队，以提升其战力。

column2: Increase Air Superiority levels to help maintain your air mission points from turn to turn.
column3: 提高制空权等级，有助于逐回合保持你的空中任务点数。

column2: Taking enemy cities adds to your prestige and might earn you a leader, a new unit, or additional air points.
column3: 攻占敌方城市可增加威望，还可能为你赢得指挥官、新部队或额外空中点数。

column2: Light Infantry units ignore enemy zones-of-control.
column3: 轻步兵单位可无视敌方控制区。

column2: Fly a defensive air mission against an enemy helicopter to make it flee from the map.
column3: 对敌方直升机执行防御性空中任务，可迫使其逃离地图。

column2: Air strikes can be used against enemy ground and air units.
column3: 空中打击可用于攻击敌方地面和空中单位。

column2: You can deploy from Combat Support units as long as they're not in an enemy zone of control.
column3: 只要战斗支援单位不在敌方控制区内，即可由其部署部队。

column2: Air mobile and plane movement ranges will lessen as your air superiority decreases.
column3: 制空权下降时，空中机动部队与飞机的移动范围会缩小。

column2: Planes may only resupply at friendly airfields and at Combat Support units.
column3: 飞机只能在友方机场或战斗支援单位处补给。

column2: Soften up entrenched units with artillery, air strikes, and ranged direct fire by certain tanks.
column3: 用炮击、空袭以及部分坦克的远程直射火力，削弱工事中的敌军。

column2: As Air Superiority goes lower, the range of Aircraft is shortened.
column3: 制空权越低，飞机的航程越短。

column2: When executing an Air Strike on a hex with both an enemy helicopter and ground unit, make sure the Air Mode button is correct.
column3: 对同时有敌方直升机与地面单位的格执行空中打击时，请确认「空中模式」按钮指向正确的目标。

column2: Replacements are free but reduce the overall experience level of the unit if taken on the battlefield.
column3: 补充兵员是免费的，但若在战场上补充，会降低部队的整体经验等级。

column2: Airmobile units cannot land in an enemy zone of control.
column3: 空中机动部队不能在敌方控制区内着陆。

column2: Light infantry units can mount, fly, dismount, move 1/2, and attack the same turn.
column3: 轻步兵单位可在同一回合内上车、飞行、下车、移动一半移动力并攻击。

column2: Units break entrenchment when they move.
column3: 部队移动即失去工事。

column2: Units that don't move entrench 1 point more each turn (up to 5 levels over the terrain's base value).
column3: 不移动的部队每回合增加 1 点工事（至多超过地形基础值 5 级）。

column2: Tanks can overrun multiple weak opponents in clear terrain.
column3: 坦克可在开阔地形中连续碾压多个弱敌。

column2: Pull weakened units off the front lines and issue replacements.
column3: 将受损部队撤出前线，并给予补充。

column2: Watch your supply in inclement weather and in deserts.
column3: 恶劣天气与沙漠中请注意补给。

column2: Night is a good time to resupply, reinforce, and entrench.
column3: 夜晚是补给、补充和构筑工事的好时机。

column2: Prestige is used to purchase and upgrade units, or to increase air superiority between campaign scenarios.
column3: 威望用于购买和升级部队，或在战役场景之间提升制空权。

column2: When requisitioning new units, buy Veteran and Elite units whenever possible.
column3: 征募新部队时，尽可能购买老兵和精锐单位。

column2: Engineer units ignore entrenchment when attacking.
column3: 工兵单位攻击时无视工事。

column2: You can't UNDO a move if by moving you discover a previously unknown unit.
column3: 如果移动中发现了此前未知的部队，该步移动无法撤销。
